text: I am inquired{H1875} of by them that asked{H7592} not{H3808} [for me]; I am found{H4672} of them that sought{H1245} me not:{H3808} I said,{H559} Behold me, behold me, unto a nation{H1471} that was not called{H7121} by my name.{H8034}
